newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS - Big Mattel straddle.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS - Big Mattel straddle.

text.p: A straddle was done in Mattel Inc options 10,000 times Friday, options traders said.
The Mattel 30 put and call each traded 10,000 contracts, the calls at prices ranging from 4-1/8 to 4-1/2 and the puts at 1/16.
"It looks like an opening straddle," said Michael Schwartz at Oppenheimer & Co, noting that open interest in both options was low.
Open interest was 816 in the July 30 call and 323 in the July 30 put.
No other Mattel options were busy.
Straddles typically involve buying or selling a put and a call at the same strike price.
In other trading, several Archer Daniels Midland Co options were busy, led by the July 25 calls, which traded 5,740 contracts.
ADM rose 1-3/8 at 23-5/8 on consolidated volume of nearly 4.6 million shares after Dain Bosworth upgraded the stock to buy from hold.
Traders said activity and volatility in ADM options had risen recently on vague takeover talk, but they generally gave the talk little credence.
One trader said he had been long the July 20 calls and short twice as many July 22-1/2 calls but unwound the position.
"I just unwound it in case there was some truth to these rumors, but I doubt it," he said.
He added that on Friday he had sold a sizable number of the July 25 calls.
